split: Deterministic SHA256(State:RouteNumber) first-byte split A/B, identical to the earlier mechanism route split.
endpoint: strong_new_score = sum of wet CallingIndex for dry=0 -> wet in {2,3} cells.
model: Same matched-pair model and route-clustered covariance as the full-sample strong activation test.
pass_rule: Both fold A and fold B strong_new_score rain_contrast coefficients >0 with complete 95% CI >0.

interpretation.pass: Strong new chorus activation internally replicates across disjoint route sets within NAAMP.
interpretation.fail: The full-sample and same-observer association remains supported, but strict disjoint-route internal replication is incomplete.
interpretation.boundary: Internal geographic replication is not cross-continental universality.
